implementation: AFriendlyNPCActor ticks a lightweight visual-only gesture layer and adds SafehouseNPCIdleServicePose plus FriendlyNPCGestureReadabilityRuntime tags.
playability_result: Engineer, Medic, Scientist, and Trader NPCs read as living support staff instead of static service markers.

implementation: TriggerServiceGrantGesture fires after a role benefit succeeds and before the selected-language cooldown save subtitle.
playability_result: The player sees a short affirmative role-prop, badge, head, skeletal-body, and light pulse when a service is granted.

implementation: TriggerServiceDeniedGesture fires for used services, full-health Medic attempts, and insufficient-scrap Trader attempts.
playability_result: Failed interactions visibly read as refusal or hold state instead of only subtitle text.

implementation: CacheServiceGestureBasePose stores the skeletal body, primitive head, role badge, role prop, role icons, and role light bases before additive offsets.
playability_result: Imported Manny, Quinn, MetaHuman, or fallback procedural role surfaces can animate without moving the root or collision body.

implementation: Successful service interactions still call MarkFriendlyNPCServiceUsed and add SelectedLanguageSupportSaveGesture.
playability_result: The gesture layer celebrates the same language-profile save path instead of creating a parallel state system.

implementation: Runtime tags include FriendlyNPCGestureReadabilityRuntime, SafehouseNPCServiceGrantPose, SafehouseNPCServiceDeniedPose, SafehouseNPCIdleServicePose, and CharacterAnimationDeepDive.
playability_result: QA screenshots and future animation validators can locate safehouse support motion readiness.
